description: Length bounds count Unicode code points, the unit JSON Schema minLength and maxLength define. A 120-code-point title of astral characters is valid; counting UTF-16 code units would make it 240 and wrongly reject it, which is why the schemas use length keywords and never a regular-expression quantifier.
